# A nonrare new sector beyond short-plus-seed constructions

This is a Gibbs-weight lower baseline, NOT an occupation lower bound.

Let L be divisible by8 and at least24. Put

    a=floor(L/3), b=floor(L/6), c=floor(5L/6).

If L is divisible by6, reduce c by1. Define row intervals of plus spins:
- For rows y>=L/2, use [a,c).
- For L/8<=y<3L/8, use [0,b).
- For all remaining rows, use [0,c).

The two wide buffers on either side of the narrow [0,b) quarter are essential: without them a periodic transition to [a,c) would disconnect the band. With these buffers the plus set is a connected vertical winding band with two disjoint axial phase interfaces.

## Exact geometry and weight
Its volume and physical perimeter are

    V=Lb/4+3Lc/4-La/2,
    P=2L+2a+2(c-b).

The actual deterministic physical-plus-resolution wall lengths are

    p_left=L+2a,   p_right=L+2(c-b).

The left wall satisfies p_left<=2L-8 for L>=24. There are no checkerboard ambiguities in the macroscopic step geometry that change these lengths; direct actual-encoding checks at L24,32,40,48,64,80 confirm the two axial cycles and formulas.

The rounding gives V<n/2. At L=8R, theta4, phi4/R,

    log[w(x)/w_minus]=2phi V-8P >= -32.

For the four actual finite instances R80,200,1000,10000 this logarithm is respectively -16,-16,0,0. The source is non-target in every case.

The existing core pressure receipt gives ZA/w_minus<=2exp(S0), with

    S0=6n(1/450)^4/(1-1/450)<1

at all four instances. Therefore even this single new-sector state has

    w(x)/ZA > exp(-34).

The universal constant is deliberately conservative. This is not an exponentially rare-in-R Gibbs sector, whereas the proposed actual-wall occupation bounds are exp(-94),exp(-567),exp(-3858),exp(-41368).

## Why this is outside the earlier simple covered seed families
There is no full plus row since c<L, and no full plus column since a>=b. All plus sites lie in the proper horizontal slab 0<=x<c, so no plus cycle can have nonzero horizontal homology; in particular there is no diagonal digital anchor.

Any vertical winding plus path must visit a row of the narrow quarter, where x<=b-1, and a row of the high-a half, where x>=a. In a proper horizontal lift its total horizontal variation is at least2(a-b+1). Its vertical variation is at leastL. Consequently EVERY plus winding path has length at least

    L+2(a-b+1) ~ 4L/3.

# Short actual physical phase walls: reviewed finite-volume occupation theorem

**Status:** coordinated proof independently reviewed by bridge and GKP, with no additional gap found in the stated short-span integration. Exact finite receipts and an explicit new-sector Gibbs baseline are available. This is not a delivered package and not the full exit theorem.

Keep the original Ising Hamiltonian, fixed core A, actual soft source, heatbath per-site clock, target B={M>=0}, voltage v and capacity C_kappa. Let L=8R and theta4, with the previously certified finite source/capacity instances.

Define H as the union of non-target configurations having an actual noncontractible wall gamma, of physical length p<=2L-8, in fluid's deterministic physical-plus-resolution encoding. This auxiliary zero-energy encoding does NOT redefine A. The length bound forces axial homology since any other primitive homology has physical length at least2L.

## Coordinated geometry contract
Fluid's documents:
- `ising_physical_phase_boundary_20261113/CONSTRUCTION.md` (physical-plus encoding, visible actual label),
- `ising_right_only_bootstrap_20261113/HOLE_FIRST_AUDIT.md` (connected essential right-minus prefixes),
- `ising_physical_phase_boundary_20261113/SHORT_SPAN_COMPLETION.md` and `PIN_CANCELLATION.md`.

The main plus collar D is NN-connected and essential with P(D)<=2p. A deterministic right-only, hole-first sequence first flattens with only >=2-neighbor additions, then grows straight columns until actual B. It preserves every plaquette bit used by gamma's adaptive encoding. The reference geometric order is independent of arbitrary extra source plus bits; those cause skips only.

Physical dual horizontal span is at most(p-L)/2. The inclusive plus-collar width is at most(p-L)/2+2<=L/2-2. After forming its rightmost full plus column, at most L/2-1 further full columns force majority. This leaves room before periodic collar pins. This argument is NOT valid for the previously proposed wider p<2.45L range.

At each queried prefix the main plus pins and right-minus pins remain connected essential sets. Frozen bounded pockets and left-side constants not adjacent to erased variables are canceled identically from the ratio.
